create_scalar_affine_bijector: create a ScalarAffine bijector with shift and scale parameters for elementwise affine transformation
test_forward_and_log_det: test the forward_and_log_det method to compute y=scale*x+shift with its log determinant
test_inverse_and_log_det: test the inverse_and_log_det method to compute x=(y-shift)/scale with its log determinant
test_batched_parameters: test ScalarAffine with batched shift and log_scale parameters across multiple input shapes
test_jittable_forward: test that ScalarAffine forward transformation is compatible with JAX JIT compilation
